name: Corrosion / death

request.text: Single dry close positional game sound effect. Immediate attack, self-contained fade, no voice, no scream, no breath, no words, no music, no ambience, no weapon firing, no reverb. Close aggressive acid etching: irregular wet sizzling bubbles, a brief dissolving squelch and a narrow chemical fizz tapering away. Bright acid corrosion; no flame whoosh.
